bio.text: Luke Bronin is the Democratic nominee for Connecticut's 1st Congressional District in 2026, an open seat; CT Mirror reports he defeated Rep. John B. Larson in the Democratic primary.
He is the former mayor of Hartford, serving from 2016 to 2024 according to his campaign website, and earlier was general counsel to Gov. Dannel P. Malloy.

His campaign website says he was a Rhodes Scholar and a Navy intelligence officer who deployed to Afghanistan, and that he worked in the Obama administration's Treasury Department, including as Deputy Assistant Secretary for Terrorist Financing and Financial Crimes.
